subject: [PATCH 1/9] memcg: make the v1 soft limit knob inert

reviews.author: Shakeel Butt (author)
reviews.summary: Author acknowledged that the soft limit knob is deprecated and has no effect, but expressed willingness to consider alternative behavior (EOPNOTSUPP) if reviewer prefers.
reviews.raw_body:
I followed the memory.kmem.limit_in_bytes example. If you have strong opinion, I
am ok with EOPNOTSUPP as well.

2026-08-14.patch_summary: This patch makes the v1 soft limit knob inert by ignoring writes to it and always returning its maximum value on read. The knob has been deprecated since Linux version 6.12, but was still being used in some cases. This change ensures that the knob behaves consistently everywhere, including PREEMPT_RT systems where soft limit reclaim is disabled. Additionally, this patch fixes a syzbot report related to memory pressure notification and removes references to the soft limit from documentation.
